Author: tanyu
Name: Custom MB Plugin
Punchline: AutoRetainer ventures plus built-in market board pinch
Description: After AutoRetainer collects a venture and assigns a quick venture, Custom MB Plugin pinches that retainer's market listings (embedded Dagobert engine) before moving to the next retainer. Requires AutoRetainer Multi-Mode. Disable the separate Dagobert plugin. Slash command: /custommb (use '/custommb config' for settings)
